description: Implementation of PovertyLineService for retrieving poverty line data related to Likelihoods and PPI in the Fineract infrastructure survey module.

classes.name: PovertyLineServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing PovertyLineService to retrieve poverty line data from database.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all poverty line data for a given PPI name, organized by likelihood.

methods.name: retrieveForLikelihood
methods.description: Retrieves poverty line data for a specific likelihood within a given PPI.

methods.name: getLikelihoods
methods.description: Private method to fetch likelihoods from database.

methods.name: getPovertyLines
methods.description: Private method to fetch poverty lines by PPI name or likelihood ID.
